subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column.
stimulus: Our parents become obedient to them and try to make them happy. We spend unhappy at our failure. They get happy at our success. They should be to make us happy. They should save money for food clothes and education. close to them and try to make them happy.
guide_solution: (a) Our parents try to make us happy. (b) We should be obedient to them and try to make them happy. (c) They spend money for food, clothes and education. (d) They become happy at our success. (e) They become unhappy at our failure.
